rules.logic: BIOC(Prisma Browser — page.screenshot() called against origin tagged sensitive — block + alert) FOLLOWED BY BIOC(Prisma Browser — page.screenshot() called against origin tagged sensitive — block + alert) BY user WITHIN 1800s → single collection incident (shared_entity: user). Repeat captures by the same user also raise XQL(Prisma Browser — repeat screen-capture from same user counts toward elevated risk score), driving the user-risk / conditional-access escalation.
rules.name: Browser Sensitive Screen Capture — Repeat Collection
